algorithm: generic deterministic layered MCP selector v2

metric_definitions.total_tool_coverage_rate_pct: unique expected (server, tool) pairs in normal cases / discovered registry tools
metric_definitions.server_recognition_accuracy_pct: labeled cases selecting the expected MCP Server / labeled cases
metric_definitions.tool_top_1_pct: labeled cases selecting the expected (server, tool) at rank 1 / labeled cases
metric_definitions.tool_top_3_pct: labeled cases containing the expected (server, tool) in Top-3 / labeled cases
metric_definitions.parameter_schema_valid_rate_pct: selected outcomes satisfying live tools/list Schema / selected outcomes
metric_definitions.nonexistent_tool_hallucination_rate_pct: unknown cases returning a selected tool / unknown cases
metric_definitions.average_candidate_count_before_filter: mean ToolRegistry candidates before layered filters
metric_definitions.average_candidate_count_after_filter: mean Schema-valid candidates after layered filters
metric_definitions.average_selection_time_ms: mean in-process wall-clock selection latency per case
metric_definitions.audit_recommendation_actual_match_pct: labeled cases whose recommendation maps to the expected current concrete/legacy contract / labeled cases
